app.name: Datapack Maker
app.tagline: Create Minecraft datapacks right in your browser
app.description: Full-featured editor with syntax highlighting, AI autocompletion, ZIP import/export and project saving. No installation required.

landing.feature1Desc: mcfunction syntax highlighted: commands, selectors, NBT, comments and macros.
landing.feature2Desc: Smart command completion powered by a language model, with a daily quota included.
landing.feature3Desc: Export a datapack ready to drop into your world, or import an existing ZIP to edit it.
landing.feature4Desc: Without an account, projects stay in your browser. With an account, they follow you everywhere.
landing.feature5Desc: Generate colored JSON text components with live preview, ready for tellraw and title.
landing.feature6Desc: Fully translated interface, in the language of your choice.
